description.zh:
防护模式。取值：

- **block**：拦截
- **audit**：告警
description.en:
The defense mode. Valid values:

- **block**: Block.
- **audit**: Alert.

description.zh: 指定防护目录，即需要防护的目录的完整路径。
description.en: The full path of the directory that you want to protect.

description.zh:
指定无需网页防篡改防护的目录地址（即排除目录）。
> 防护模式**Mode**配置为**blacklist**时，您需要配置该参数。
description.en:
The directory that does not require web tamper-proofing protection (excluded directory).
> This parameter is required when the protection pattern **Mode** is set to **blacklist**.

description.zh:
指定无需开启网页防篡改防护的文件（即排除文件）。
> 防护模式**Mode**配置为**blacklist**时，您需要配置该参数。
description.en:
The file that does not require web tamper-proofing protection (excluded file).
> This parameter is required when the protection pattern **Mode** is set to **blacklist**.

description.zh:
指定无需网页防篡改防护的文件类型（即排除文件的类型）。存在多个文件类型时，使用半角分号（;）隔开。取值：
- php
- jsp
- asp
- aspx
- js
- cgi
- html
- htm
- xml
- shtml
- shtm
- jpg
- gif
- png

> 防护模式**Mode**配置为**blacklist**时，您需要配置该参数。
description.en:
The file types that do not require web tamper-proofing protection (excluded file types). Separate multiple file types with semicolons (;). Valid values:
- php
- jsp
- asp
- aspx
- js
- cgi
- html
- htm
- xml
- shtml
- shtm
- jpg
- gif
- png

> This parameter is required when the protection pattern **Mode** is set to **blacklist**.

description.zh:
指定需要修改的防护目录配置的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeWebLockConfigList](~~DescribeWebLockConfigList~~)接口获取防护目录的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the protected directory configuration that you want to modify.
> You can call the [DescribeWebLockConfigList](~~DescribeWebLockConfigList~~) operation to obtain the ID of the protected directory.

description.zh:
指定需要防护的文件。
> 防护模式**Mode**配置为**whitelist**时，您需要配置该参数。
description.en:
The file that requires protection.
> This parameter is required when the protection pattern **Mode** is set to **whitelist**.

description.zh:
指定需要网页防篡改防护的文件类型。存在多个文件类型时，使用半角分号（;）隔开。取值：
- php
- jsp
- asp
- aspx
- js
- cgi
- html
- htm
- xml
- shtml
- shtm
- jpg
- gif
- png

> 防护模式**Mode**配置为**whitelist**时，您需要配置该参数。
description.en:
The file types that require web tamper-proofing protection. Separate multiple file types with semicolons (;). Valid values:
- php
- jsp
- asp
- aspx
- js
- cgi
- html
- htm
- xml
- shtml
- shtm
- jpg
- gif
- png

> This parameter is required when the protection pattern **Mode** is set to **whitelist**.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

description.zh:
指定本地备份路径，用于对防护目录进行安全备份。  
Linux服务器和Windows服务器防护目录地址的格式可能会有区别，请您确保输入正确的格式。您可以参考以下目录格式：
 - Linux服务器：/usr/local/aegis/bak
 - Windows服务器：C:\Program Files (x86)\Alibaba\Aegis\bak
description.en:
The local backup path for securely backing up the protected directory.  
The format of the directory path may differ between Linux servers and Windows servers. Make sure that you enter the correct format. Refer to the following directory formats:
 - Linux server: /usr/local/aegis/bak
 - Windows server: C:\Program Files (x86)\Alibaba\Aegis\bak.

description.zh:
指定防护模式。取值：
- **whitelist**：白名单模式，对添加的防护目录和文件类型进行保护。
- **blacklist**：黑名单模式，对添加的防护目录下所有未排除的子目录、文件类型和指定文件进行保护。
description.en:
The protection pattern. Valid values:
- **whitelist**: whitelist mode. Protects only the specified directories and file types.
- **blacklist**: blacklist mode. Protects all subdirectories, file types, and files under the specified directory except those that are excluded.
The IP address of the access source.

description.zh:
指定需要修改防护目录的服务器的UUID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取服务器的UUID。
description.en:
The UUID of the server whose protected directory you want to modify.
> You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain the UUID of the server.

title.zh: 编辑指定服务器的防护策略
title.en: Modify the protection policy of a specified server

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-web-lock-update-config --source-ip 36.112.XX.XX --lang zh --id 312077 --uuid 4fe8e1cd-3c37-4851-b9de-124da32c0000 --dir /home/admin/tomcat --exclusive-dir /home/admin/test --exclusive-file-type jpg --local-backup-dir /usr/local/backup --biz-mode blacklist --inclusive-file-type jpg --exclusive-file /home/admin/apache.log --inclusive-file /home/admin/test.log --defence-mode block --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyWebLockUpdateConfig --region cn-hangzhou --InclusiveFileType jpg --ExclusiveDir '/home/admin/test' --Mode blacklist --Lang zh --Dir '/home/admin/tomcat' --InclusiveFile '/home/admin/test.log' --ExclusiveFile '/home/admin/apache.log' --SourceIp '36.112.XX.XX' --Uuid '4fe8e1cd-3c37-4851-b9de-124da32c0000' --DefenceMode block --LocalBackupDir '/usr/local/backup' --ExclusiveFileType jpg --Id 312077
